text:
Mira Patel: Quick sync — planning a canary deploy for Turbine-7B (fp16 quant) into the model catalog tomorrow 11:00 PST. Goal: smoke latency/quality vs the current turbine-7b-v1 pin in prod. Who can own the deploy + smoke checks?

Ajay Rao: I can do the deploy. I'll be OOO after 13:00 PST so want to get it early.

Samir Chen: I can watch metrics and run the eval harness. What should the smoke checklist be?

Mira Patel: Smoke checklist (short):
- pin canary as "turbine-7b-canary" in catalog
- route 5% traffic to canary
- run eval suite "smoke_suite_1" (quality prompts)
- validate latency p95 < 230ms and token-level regression < 0.5%
- sanity check embeddings similarity on a small probe set

Oscar Li: I'll prepare the rollback/failover policy. Auto-rollback triggers: latency p95 > 300ms for 2 consecutive 1-min windows OR error rate > 1%.

deploy-bot: Please create a deploy PR referencing infra/infra#842 and add the canary flag.

Lia Gomez: Need the model artifact location + checksum and the quant config file before I sign off.

Ajay Rao: Artifact is at s3://redwood-models/turbine/7b/2026-03-16/quant.fp16.tar.gz. SHA256: a3f9d7b4c2e1f8d6b0c9e4a2f7d1b6c3e5f8a9b0c7d6e4f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9 (truncated for chat). I'll put full hash in the PR.

Samir Chen: Smoke commands I'll run after deploy:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -d '{"model":"turbine-7b-canary","input":"<smoke input>"}'
```
And I'll run the eval harness: `python eval/run.py --suite smoke_suite_1 --model turbine-7b-canary`

Mira Patel: Plan summary:
- 11:00 PST: Ajay deploys turbine-7b-canary (5% traffic)
- 11:05 PST: Samir runs smoke checks + perf dashboards go-live
- 11:10-11:25 PST: monitor for regressions; Lia verifies artifact/hash; Oscar stands by with rollback config
- 11:25 PST: if green, increase to 25%

Ajay Rao: Acknowledged. I'll open the PR now and link this thread. Will tag the infra change and canary flag.

Lia Gomez: Confirm I have read access to that S3 path, will verify checksum by EOD today.

deploy-bot: Auto-checklist update: PR created: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/1789 — remember to add the canary tag and release notes.

Mira Patel: :thumbsup: Good. Tagging @eng-oncall so they're aware of the canary window in case traffic anomalies pop up.

Samir Chen: I'll capture logs and metric snapshots at 11:05 and 11:20. If anything odd, ping me and I'll trigger the rollback.

Oscar Li: Rollback playbook ready and tested. I'll execute if deploy breaches rollback thresholds.

Ajay Rao: I'll post a final deploy completion message in this thread once done.

Mira Patel: Thanks everyone — smooth and minimal risk.
